title: Model gateway
description: The contents of gateway.yml: the model gateway every run calls its model through (LiteLLM on hosta, app-gitops apps/hetzner/hosta/llm-gateway), the internal address the runner reaches it at, and the private CA root it is pinned to.

url.description: Where the runner reaches the gateway: an https URL at an internal address (no public name, no path). Only the runner process calls it; the box never does.

server_name.description: The name the gateway's certificate is issued for (GATEWAY_HOST in the stack's .env). The runner sends it as the TLS server name and checks the certificate against it, so the URL may be an address.

team.description: The LiteLLM team every run key belongs to; the issuer key can issue keys for this team only.

ca.description: The file at the repository root holding the gateway's private CA root certificate (PEM). The runner trusts only this root when it talks to the gateway.

key_max_usd.description: The most a key may be given to spend: the gateway's own ceiling (upperbound_key_generate_params.max_budget). A run whose worst case is higher is refused before any key is asked for.

key_max_minutes.description: The longest a key may live: the gateway's own ceiling (upperbound_key_generate_params.duration), in minutes.
